levels.surface: أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمذاني

notes: The chain is cut: «علی بن إبراهیم بن» runs straight into «عن أبيه» in the text; the name is read as written up to «إبراهیم»
The Imam is named in the words after the chain («حُبِسَ فِيهِ الرِّضَا»): last link by owner ruling 2
Ruling 11: a narrated encounter in which the Imam speaks; source or only scene is for a reviewer
«قال أبو الصلت» is the narrator himself (عبد السلام), not a new link
